Why are black olives so much weaker than men?

Black olives aren’t “weaker” than men—they’re food, not people. Nutritionally, they’re mostly fat and water with relatively little protein, so they won’t support muscle strength the way a balanced diet and exercise do. Strength also varies widely between individual people, regardless of gender.
